ROLE
You are a senior frontend architect. This is phase A00 of the FixMate project: a read-only repository audit.

PROJECT CONTEXT
FixMate is an on-demand smart-device and home-appliance repair booking platform with three roles
(customer, technician, admin). I split the work in two:
- YOU (OpenCode): UI/UX design, layouts, reusable presentational components, responsive design,
  static mock data for previews, and visual asset collection.
- ME (manually): ALL functionality: BetterAuth, sessions, JWT, role authorization, MongoDB, Express
  APIs, CRUD, booking logic, ImgBB upload, Stripe, and every business rule.

TASK
Inspect this repository thoroughly. DO NOT edit, create, or delete any file in this phase. DO NOT
install packages. DO NOT run any command that changes the project.

Read: package.json, framework config files, the app/pages directory, existing components, global
styles, Tailwind config, fonts, public assets, and eslint config.

REQUIRED ROUTES (check which exist and which are missing)
Public: /, /services, /services/[id], /about, /sign-up, /sign-in, /payment/success, /payment/cancel,
and a not-found page.
Customer: /dashboard/customer, /dashboard/customer/bookings, /dashboard/customer/payments
Technician: /dashboard/technician, /dashboard/technician/add-service,
/dashboard/technician/my-services, /dashboard/technician/requests
Admin: /dashboard/admin, /dashboard/admin/users, /dashboard/admin/services,
/dashboard/admin/bookings, /dashboard/admin/transactions
Shared: /dashboard/profile
Layouts: a public layout (Navbar + Footer) and a separate dashboard layout (sidebar + top bar,
NO public footer).

EXPECTED OUTPUT (report only, in the chat)
1. Current stack: framework + version, router type, JavaScript or TypeScript, styling approach,
   package manager, installed UI/icon/toast libraries.
2. Folder/file map relevant to UI.
3. Table of required routes: exists / missing.
4. Existing components and styles worth reusing.
5. Proposed UI-only plan grouped into small phases.
6. Exact list of files and folders that must NEVER be modified in later phases (auth config/client,
   API routes/handlers, server code, database code, middleware, env files, payment/upload
   integrations, business logic).
7. Risks, conflicts, and any essential questions.
8. Whether lint/build commands exist, and the exact commands.

FILES YOU MAY MODIFY: none in this phase.
FILES YOU MUST NOT MODIFY: all files.

COMPLETION CHECKLIST (confirm each in your final message)
[ ] I did not edit, create, or delete any file
[ ] I did not install any package
[ ] I reported stack, folder map, route table, reusable parts, plan, protected files, risks
[ ] I listed every file I read

STOP after the report and wait for my approval. Do not start the next phase.
